topics.title: Introduction, Occupation, Production and Business Units

subtopics.content: Scope of Commerce/E-Commerce, occupations, factors of production, division of labour, business ownership structures, amalgamations
subtopics.objective: Define and trace the background and scope of Commerce and E-Commerce[cite: 176]; classify industrial, commercial, and service occupations[cite: 176]; analyze factors/types of production and division of labour[cite: 176, 177]; evaluate forms of business units (sole proprietorship, partnership, companies, public enterprises, co-operatives)[cite: 177]; examine mergers, amalgamations, cartels, trusts, and liquidation processes[cite: 177].

topics.title: Trade Associations, Capital/Profits, Home and Foreign Trade

subtopics.content: Trade associations, business capital/turnover calculation, retail/wholesale trade, channels of distribution, international trade concepts, tariffs
subtopics.objective: Understand roles of Trade Associations and Chambers of Commerce[cite: 177]; calculate working capital, profits, and turnover[cite: 178]; differentiate retail types, wholesale middleman functions, and channels of distribution[cite: 178, 179]; explain foreign trade (imports, exports, entrepôt), balance of trade/payments, tariffs, customs, and port authorities[cite: 179].

topics.title: Purchase & Sale Documents, Finance, Banking, Insurance, Capital/Stock/Commodity Markets

subtopics.content: Commercial documents, price quotations, payment instruments, money/banking, insurance principles, stock/commodity exchange
subtopics.objective: Understand trade documents (invoices, LPO, credit/debit notes, certificate of origin)[cite: 180]; interpret price terms (CIF, FOB, COD) and payment means (cheques, electronic transfers)[cite: 180]; trace evolution and functions of money and banking types (Central, Commercial, Microfinance, E-Banking)[cite: 180, 181]; apply insurance principles (indemnity, insurable interest)[cite: 181, 182]; analyze capital market fund-raising, stock exchange operations, and commodity trading[cite: 182, 183].

topics.title: Transport, Tourism, Communication, Warehousing, Advertising, Marketing, Legal Aspects, Government Policies, Business Management & Economic Groupings

subtopics.content: Transport modes/documents, tourism, communication networks, warehousing, advertising, 4 Ps marketing mix, sales promotion, business law/regulations, commercialization/privatization, management functions, regional economic blocs
subtopics.objective: Compare transport forms and shipping documents[cite: 183]; evaluate tourism and postal/courier/electronic communication services[cite: 183, 184]; classify warehousing types[cite: 185]; evaluate advertising media and sales promotion techniques[cite: 185, 186]; apply 4 Ps of marketing mix and customer services[cite: 185, 186]; examine contract law, agency, sales of goods, consumer protection acts, and business registration[cite: 186, 187]; compare commercialization, privatization, and deregulation[cite: 187]; understand business management functions, organizational charts, and corporate social responsibility[cite: 187, 188]; evaluate economic integration bodies (ECOWAS, EU, Niger/Lake Chad Basin Commissions)[cite: 188].
